0.9.39 dt-image-gen: added a raster image-generation skill that wraps Codex's built-in image_gen tool (the gpt-image-2 engine), running on Danny's ChatGPT subscription with no OPENAI_API_KEY and no per-image billing. Thin orchestration layer over Codex's existing .system/imagegen engine, not a reimplementation. Taken through dt-review (complex tier, converged in 3 rounds) before merge; the review hardened the engine substantially. scripts/gen-image.sh drives codex exec headless (prompt on stdin via the Bash tool, --dangerously-bypass-approvals-and-sandbox -s danger-full-access) and owns a race-safe collection contract: it never hands Codex a save path (Codex resolves caller paths through .NET/PowerShell, so a bash /tmp/x.png lands at C:\tmp\x.png), instead collecting via before/after UUID-directory set-diff under generated_images (not mtime -newer), under a stale-aware per-run lock (run-id|PID|start, PID-liveness reclaim, --force-unlock), with fail-closed counts (exactly one new PNG per generation; 0 or unexpected >1 is a typed error with the stream-log path; --allow-extra takes newest and logs the rest), a prompt data-envelope (prompt-injection boundary under the full-access posture), --count for batch variants, --ref reference passthrough (normalized to Windows paths), and a visible generation-call-count estimate. Deterministic helpers: make-grid-prompt.mjs (5x5 numbered-grid prompt), crop-grid-cell.mjs (dependency-free PNG decode/unfilter/crop/re-encode for composition-preserving cell refinement, NOT a pixel upscale), resolve-assets-dir.mjs (project assets-folder resolution), brand-preamble.mjs (templates resolved design-system values; never hand-copies them), convert-ref.sh (PDF->PNG via pdftoppm/ImageMagick/Ghostscript, fail-clear if none), make-gallery.mjs (self-contained master-detail gallery.html). Modes: single, batch, 5x5 grid-variation. Trigger is broad -- fires whenever a raster image/visual is the right output, including when Claude decides so itself -- but code-native output (Mermaid/SVG charts/diagrams, existing vector/logo systems, simple shapes) wins by default. Brand styling opt-in. Verified end-to-end on 2026-06-13: live generation -> race-safe collect -> move, plus crop + all helpers. Default save location is the current project's assets folder. No other skill behavior change.

0.9.37 start-work-named-surface-fast-path: start-work now has a fast-path for when Danny names the git surface in plain language, skipping the classify-score-confirm dance entirely. 'start a feat/feature named X' -> medium (creates and checks out feat/X); 'make a new worktree/tree named X' -> heavy (creates ..\<repo>-X, and the skill then calls the EnterWorktree tool to switch the session into it -- the script can only create the tree on disk, only the agent can switch the session). SKILL.md gains a '## Fast-path: surface already named (no classification)' section above the full Procedure with the detection phrases, slug derivation (exact names used verbatim, even jokey ones; script still rejects empty/over-generic slugs), and the medium/heavy run steps; the full classify Procedure still applies when the request is vague about feat-vs-worktree. Description frontmatter documents the two fast-path triggers. scripts/start-work.ps1: heavy tier now best-effort copies gitignored per-worktree env files (.env.local, .env, .env.development.local, supabase/.env.local) from the source tree into the new worktree so it can run immediately (Vite dev / supabase functions serve), reported as a new copied_env JSON field and in the heavy text summary; copy failures never fail the setup. Surfaced 2026-06-03 creating the email-campaign-wiring worktree by hand. No other skill behavior change.

0.9.36 git-merge-feature-worktree-aware: git-merge-feature (SKILL 1.0.0 -> 1.1.0) now handles a feature branch checked out in a git worktree -- the normal trunk-based case, which previously failed at `git checkout <branch>` with 'already used by worktree at <path>'. scripts/merge-feature.ps1 detects a worktree-resident branch via `git worktree list --porcelain`, rebases inside that worktree onto refreshed main, fast-forward merges from the primary tree, then `git worktree remove` before `git branch -d`; the JSON summary gains worktree_path / worktree_removed. The non-worktree path is byte-for-byte unchanged, and the ff-only / confirm-before-delete guarantees hold. Surfaced 2026-06-03 merging feat/margin-capture (tcm-database) from its worktree, which had to be merged by hand. SKILL.md documents the same worktree-aware fallback. No other skill behavior change.

0.9.34 dt-roadmap-bold-aware-milestone-naming: dt-roadmap (SKILL 1.1.0 -> 1.1.1) fixes Get-FirstSentence in skills/dt-roadmap/scripts/build-roadmap.ps1 so a milestone whose `## Implementation Sequence` item leads with a bold title (`**Title.**`) extracts that title as the milestone name instead of capturing the whole paragraph. Root cause: the first-sentence regex `^(.+?[.!?])(\s|$)` only breaks on a terminator followed by whitespace, and a bold-led title puts the period inside the `**` with no trailing space, so it ran on to the next period-space (or the 80-char truncation), yielding unreadable blob names in the milestone table, dependency-graph nodes, and Gantt rows. Surfaced on the 2026-06-03 file-sorter learning-loop-date-extraction roadmap, whose 10 sequence items had to be reworded to plain sentences as a workaround. Fix adds a non-greedy `^\*\*(.+?)\*\*` capture (trimmed of trailing .!?: , returned when 1..80 chars, else falls through), so plain-sentence items are byte-for-byte unchanged and bold-led items now name cleanly. SKILL.md input contract documents the bold-title-as-name behavior. No schema_version or producer_current_version change (producer-internal name refinement; matches the 0.9.30 producer-bugfix precedent). No other skill behavior change.

0.9.30 dt-roadmap-empty-commands-strictmode-fix: fixed a StrictMode crash in skills/dt-roadmap/scripts/build-roadmap.ps1 (the deterministic roadmap producer). When a milestone's commands list ended up empty (@()), PowerShell stored it on the augmented PSCustomObject as $null, so the 'milestones missing commands' detection at line 332 evaluated $_.commands.Count and threw 'The property Count cannot be found on this object' under Set-StrictMode -Version Latest -- aborting the entire build before any roadmap.md was written. Same fragility at line 351 ($m.commands.Count). Both now wrap in @(...).Count, which re-expands $null/scalar to a countable array, so the producer's intended 'missing commands -> Producer Warnings / validator VERIFICATION_NAMES_NO_RUNNABLE' path runs instead of crashing. Surfaced on the 2026-05-28 file-sorter Queue UX Redesign roadmap build (all 6 milestones actually had commands; the crash was purely the empty-array footgun in the detection path). No schema, contract, or other-skill behavior change.

0.9.29 dt-review-self-healing-model-resolution: fixed the recurring dt-review Codex-model breakage (the 'gpt-5.1-codex-max model is not supported when using Codex with a ChatGPT account' failure). Root cause was two stacked faults: (1) a prior review run bypassed the deterministic scripts and hand-rolled per-item codex calls (files named codex-out-p1a.txt/p1b instead of the skill's review-v<N>.md), and those calls omitted --model, so Codex fell through to ~/.codex/config.toml's default; (2) at that time the config default was gpt-5.1-codex-max, a model OpenAI had made API-only. The config default has since been corrected to gpt-5.5, and both dt-review pins (gpt-5.5 COMPLEX, gpt-5.3-codex LIGHT/PREFLIGHT) probe-tested OK on 2026-05-28 -- so the skill's pins were already valid; the fragility was that hardcoded pins rot on every model rotation and any non-script codex call inherits the config default. Durable fix: new shared scripts/resolve-codex-model.ps1 (Resolve-CodexModel -Tier light|complex -PreferredModel <pin>) reads Codex's live per-account cache (~/.codex/models_cache.json), prefers the pin when selectable, falls back through a curated per-tier candidate list (complex: gpt-5.5,gpt-5.4,gpt-5.2; light: gpt-5.3-codex,gpt-5.3-codex-spark,gpt-5.4-mini,gpt-5.4,gpt-5.5), soft-degrades to the pin with a warning if the cache is missing/unparseable, and throws an actionable error listing what IS selectable when nothing resolves -- instead of writing a failure log that looks like a critique. Wired into skills/dt-review/scripts/preflight-codex.ps1 and invoke-codex-round.ps1 (both gain -Tier light|complex; invoke-codex-round JSON output now reports the actually-resolved model). SKILL.md 1.2.1 -> 1.3.0: operating constants document self-heal and require -Tier; Steps 2-3 and the Execution-model section pass -Tier; deterministic-scripts list adds resolve-codex-model.ps1. Refreshed the workspace Codex model matrix (00_Resources/codex-cli-usage.md, outside this repo) to the live 2026-05-28 cache: added gpt-5.4-mini/gpt-5.3-codex-spark/gpt-5.2 rows, documented gpt-5.1-codex-max as gone/blocked with the incident note, marked the resolver candidate lists as the runtime mirror of the matrix, and corrected the last-verified date. dt-build does not yet pin a model; the shared resolver is in place for it to adopt later.

0.9.26 dt-review-codex-invocation-fix: fixed dt-review (SKILL.md 1.1.1 -> 1.2.0) codex-round execution, which was hanging 70+ minutes or silently dropping output. Fixes: skills/dt-review/scripts/invoke-codex-round.ps1 now pipes the prompt to codex over stdin (no argv) and ValidateSets -ReasoningEffort; preflight-codex.ps1 gains -ReasoningEffort (default low) and stdin. SKILL.md adds an 'Execution model' section mandating every script run through the Bash tool as 'pwsh -NoProfile -File' with a per-step timeout, never the PowerShell tool; Steps 2 and 3 pass -Model/-ReasoningEffort per tier. Added per-tier reasoning-effort constants (LIGHT/PREFLIGHT=low, COMPLEX=medium) to override the global model_reasoning_effort=high that made every round -- even the preflight 'reply OK' -- run a full deep-reasoning pass (tens of thousands of tokens). Verified end-to-end: a real invoke-codex-round.ps1 run returns in seconds with review-v<N>.md + redacted stream + provenance JSON, and parse-verdict.ps1 reads the verdict.

0.9.22 dt-build-per-milestone-multi-check-acceptance: dt-build (v2.3.1 -> v2.4.0) per-milestone acceptance gate now evaluates EVERY verification-manifest row whose milestone-id matches the requested milestone, not just the first. Prior implementation in skills/dt-build/scripts/verify-milestone-acceptance.ps1 used `$verificationRows | Where-Object { ... } | Select-Object -First 1`, so any milestone with more than one CHK-* row got partial gate coverage — only the first check's procedure cell was parsed for artifacts/commands and only its named test command was run under -RunTests. Calibration event: 2026-05-27 db-durability build at D:\Claude\_Claude-Workspace\OneDrive Migration\File Sorter\file-sorter, where M02 (three checks: CHK-M02-POPULATED-UPGRADE, CHK-M02-ROLLBACK, CHK-M02-STALE-V11-REGRESSION) reported PASS by running only CHK-M02-POPULATED-UPGRADE; ROLLBACK and STALE-V11-REGRESSION were skipped despite both being load-bearing in the roadmap. The M14 acceptance bundle script recovered coverage at the end of the build, but per-milestone the gate was only judging one check per milestone. Three coordinated changes. (1) skills/dt-build/scripts/verify-milestone-acceptance.ps1 — replaced `-First 1` with full-row iteration; per-row evaluation extracts artifacts/commands from each procedure cell, presence-checks each row's artifacts against the working tree, and (with -RunTests) runs each row's named commands. JSON output adds a new `verification_checks` array (each element exposes check_id, procedure_text, artifacts_named, artifacts_present, artifacts_missing, commands_named, command_results, test_status, blockers) alongside the existing top-level fields (status/accepted/blockers/artifacts_missing/commands_named/command_results/test_status), which remain the rolled-up view consumed by build-acceptance-ledger.ps1. status is PASS only when every check's blockers are empty. ConvertTo-Json -Depth raised from 6 to 8 to surface the new array; text-output branch now lists each check with its exit codes. (2) skills/dt-build/scripts/build-acceptance-ledger.ps1 — ledgerRows carry verification_checks through from the verify result; HTML ledger gains a Verification Check Detail section below the main table with one sub-table per milestone listing each CHK-* id, status badge, named artifacts (missing markers), and named commands with per-command exit-code badges. Markdown ledger stays as the roll-up. (3) skills/dt-build/references/acceptance-contract.md — protocol step 1 now reads 'quote EVERY verification check for the milestone'; step 4 requires every check to pass on its own merits; step 5 documents the new verification_checks JSON shape and the rolled-up status semantics; the Test-count parity section names the 2026-05-27 db-durability run as the calibration event for the change. Regression-tested against db-durability/roadmap.md: M01 (2), M02 (3), M03 (2), M04 (4), M05 (3), M06 (4), M07 (3), M14 (2) checks per milestone — every named CHK-* row's pytest command now runs and contributes to the verdict.

0.9.21 dt-roadmap-acceptance-gate-compatibility: dt-roadmap (v1.0.1 -> v1.1.0) hardened so its output is structurally compatible with dt-build's per-milestone acceptance gate. Closes the producer/consumer drift surfaced on 2026-05-27: dt-build v2.3.0 added a gate that hard-rejects any verification-manifest cell that doesn't name a runnable artifact, but dt-roadmap was never updated, so its deterministic producer emitted roadmaps that the gate blocked on every milestone with 'roadmap verification check names no concrete test file or command.' Three coordinated layer changes. (1) Schema (skills/dt-roadmap/references/roadmap-schema.md): producer_current_version 1.0.0 -> 1.1.0; added VERIFICATION_NAMES_NO_RUNNABLE error code and a canonical 'runnable artifact' definition mirroring the dt-build extractor. schema_version stays at major 1 (additive enforcement). (2) Validator (skills/dt-roadmap/scripts/roadmap-validator.ps1): now dot-sources repo-level scripts/extract-named-artifacts.ps1 (byte-identical to the inline Extract-NamedArtifacts function inside skills/dt-build/scripts/verify-milestone-acceptance.ps1; dt-build's inline copy is annotated with the cross-pointer but otherwise unchanged); fails closed with VERIFICATION_NAMES_NO_RUNNABLE per milestone when the combined acceptance-checks + matching verification procedure surface names nothing runnable. (3) Producer (skills/dt-roadmap/scripts/build-roadmap.ps1): primary input parser now derives milestones from a `## Implementation Sequence` (or `Implementation Order` / `Build Sequence` / `Build Order` / `Milestone Sequence`) section's enumerated top-level numbered list (legacy `### Phase ...` parsing kept as back-compat fallback); concrete pytest/python commands are lifted verbatim from milestone-tagged bullets in `## Validation Gates` (convention `- M<NN>: ... `cmd``) into procedure cells, replacing the prior stub prose ('Run acceptance checks for M01 and capture PASS/FAIL evidence.') that could never satisfy the gate. Producer surfaces any milestone without a lifted command in a new `## Producer Warnings` section so the validator's hard-fail is predictable. Regression-tested against the hand-edited db-durability roadmap (PASSes validator) and a fresh regeneration from db-durability/design-final.md (PASSes validator; dt-build gate then reports each milestone as PASS or BLOCKED with specific 'named artifact missing' blockers — the bug blocker is eliminated from every possible producer output).

0.9.20 dt-build-acceptance-gate-fixes: dt-build (v2.3.0 -> v2.3.1) patches two contract-completeness issues surfaced by the 2026-05-27 Codex rebuild of the file-sorter learning loop. (1) verify-milestone-acceptance.ps1 now transforms `pytest ...` to `python -m pytest ...` before subprocess invocation so `pwsh -NoProfile` (which strips the user's venv Scripts/ from PATH) finds the test runner -- previously every milestone whose verification check used the roadmap's `pytest` convention false-BLOCKED even when the tests passed when run directly. (2) build-acceptance-ledger.ps1 now reads `downgrade_approved_by: <upn>` markers from the run folder's build-decision-log.md per milestone via a new Parse-ApprovalSection helper; BLOCKED rows with an approval flip to a new third status `APPROVED_DOWNGRADE` and surface the rationale + originally-blocked items as Notes annotations. Wires the approval mechanism the acceptance-contract.md already documented but did not previously have machinery behind. APPROVED_DOWNGRADE is its own status (not PASS) so the audit trail stays visible -- a build with one APPROVED_DOWNGRADE row is shipped-with-receipts; a build with even one BLOCKED row is not shipped. Approval does not cascade to dependent milestones (each runs on its own merits).

0.9.19 dt-build-acceptance-contract-gate: dt-build (v2.2.0 -> v2.3.0) now enforces a per-milestone verify-before-complete acceptance contract instead of verify-at-end. New reference: skills/dt-build/references/acceptance-contract.md (the binding contract — quote verification check, build chunk, run named pytest/script command, scan for downgrade language, append acceptance row, only then advance). New scripts: skills/dt-build/scripts/verify-milestone-acceptance.ps1 (extracts artifacts the roadmap names per milestone, checks presence in the working tree, with -RunTests runs named pytest/python commands and folds exit codes into PASS/BLOCKED verdict), skills/dt-build/scripts/check-downgrade-language.ps1 (banned-phrase scanner calibrated against the 2026-05-27 file-sorter learning-loop post-mortem; flags 'compatible fallback', 'deterministic fallback', 'hash fallback', 'production can replace', 'scaffold implementation', 'verifier passes' paired with artifact-missing context, etc., with downgrade_approved_by: danny block override), skills/dt-build/scripts/identify-load-bearing.ps1 (parses roadmap, flags milestones whose name/acceptance/verification text contains load-bearing / gate / publish / persistence / runtime-flip / E2E / critical-path triggers; build orders these first within their DAG layer), skills/dt-build/scripts/build-acceptance-ledger.ps1 (aggregates per-milestone results into build-acceptance-ledger.md + build-acceptance-ledger.html with the four-axis split: implemented / tested / accepted / status, plus blockers and downgrade-language matches). The ledger replaces the freeform build summary as the build's final answer. Closes the failure class where a build is reported complete while load-bearing E2E coverage, named integration hooks, real model artifacts, and state-machine guards are missing or substituted with placeholders that satisfy thinner tests.

0.9.18 determinism-composability-extractions: extracted five AI-interpreted procedures to deterministic scripts and consolidated two shared patterns. New scripts: skills/git-sync-features/scripts/sync-features.ps1 (whole-skill git sequence), skills/git-merge-feature/scripts/merge-feature.ps1 (rebase + ff-merge + delete), scripts/git/rebase-onto-dev.ps1 (shared rebase helper called by both), skills/dt-app-launcher/scripts/verify-launcher.ps1 (Edge hardening + .lnk target verification, replaces hand-interpreted bullet checklist; dt-app-launcher bumped 0.2.0 -> 0.3.0), skills/dt-writing-edit/scripts/next-edit-version.ps1 (deterministic edit-version filename resolution), skills/dt-handoff/scripts/prep-handoff-folder.ps1 (folder prep + existing-file listing + canonical save-paths). New references: references/voice-load-order.md (canonical three-layer voice-reference load order, replaces inline restatement in dt-writing-draft + dt-writing-edit). Consolidated references/conventions.md with the output-paths convention (bare absolute paths, no computer:// links), pointer-swapped from dt-writing-draft, dt-writing-edit, dt-plan (1.0.1 -> 1.0.2), and dt-visualize-plan (1.0.1 -> 1.0.2). No visibility/frontmatter changes.

0.9.17 dt-build-skill-propagation-gate: dt-build (v2.2.0) now runs a final-gate skill-junction reconciler whenever the built repo is danny-skills. The new repo-level scripts\verify-skill-junctions.ps1 diffs skills/ between the merge base and the build branch, materializes per-skill directory junctions across $CODEX_HOME\skills, ~\.agents\skills, D:\Claude\skills, and _Claude-Workspace\.claude\skills, and hard-fails the build on any missing/wrong-target/setup-gap/orphan result. Same script is callable ad-hoc as a one-shot sweep. Closes the recurring invisible-new-skill gap that hid dt-app-launcher from Codex and dt-prototype from two of the four CLI surfaces until the 2026-05-26 manual backfill.
